claim_under_test: Auditory processing may contain reproducible path-dependent transport structure between heterogeneous representational states. A holonomy interpretation is admissible only if a loop-sensitive invariant predicts held-out observations beyond matched conventional dynamical controls and survives representation attacks.

primary_objects.path_transport: PT_gamma = composition of declared transports along gamma
primary_objects.warning: Non-zero loop defect is not sufficient evidence for geometric holonomy.

primary_prediction: A preregistered loop-sensitive statistic improves held-out prediction beyond matched conventional dynamical controls and its success/failure conclusion is stable under admissible invertible reparameterizations.
secondary_prediction: Only after the primary prediction survives, a parity-matched hypercomplex local algebra may add held-out predictive value or expose a preregistered invariant not reproduced by matched real-valued controls.
baselines: higher-order real-valued model with comparable interaction order
dynamic/context-dependent real-valued model with comparable gating/topology freedom
representation_attacks: scale transformations with corresponding metric normalization where required

data_split_policy.validation: used only for preregistered model selection/tuning budget
data_split_policy.test: held out from metric design, representation design, and tuning
data_split_policy.independent_witness: required for promotion beyond this internal experiment

A1.promote_if: Order/history dependence is reproducible on held-out data with uncertainty excluding the preregistered negligible-effect region.
A1.kill_if: Effect is indistinguishable from the negligible-effect region or attributable to preprocessing/data leakage.

A2.promote_if: Loop-sensitive residual survives identity/no-op, shuffle, seed, and held-out controls.
A2.kill_if: Residual is reproduced by null loops, disappears under held-out evaluation, or is unstable across seeds.

A3.promote_if: Loop/transport formulation adds held-out predictive information beyond every matched conventional dynamical control and conclusion survives representation attacks.
A3.kill_if: A matched ordinary dynamical model explains the effect equally well, or the conclusion flips under admissible representation changes.

A4.promote_if: Hypercomplex variant yields reproducible parity-matched held-out advantage or a preregistered invariant unavailable to matched real-valued models.
A4.kill_if: No reproducible advantage remains after resource parity and representation controls.

A5.kill_if: not applicable; remains semantic outside experimental scope

stop_rules: If A3 is killed, stop geometric escalation for this result and do not introduce richer geometry solely to rescue it.
If A4 is killed, retain any surviving transport measurement but retire hypercomplex necessity.
Do not interpret failed controls after seeing outcomes by changing the primary claim; amendments must be prospective and timestamped.
independence_rule: The authoring model cannot promote its own claim using only artifacts it authored. Promotion requires at least one witness materially independent in data, code path, assumptions, or authorship.
forbidden_inferences: sound and mind are the same physical vibration
nonzero loop defect implies geometric holonomy
successful auditory model establishes consciousness theory
mathematical richness is evidence of biological truth
